title: Backlit Paper Lantern — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Light passes through the lantern layers
scenes.purpose: Show the idea (bulb cutout) handing its light to a far paper wall, whose narrow opening reveals the connected-system outline.
visuals: Quiet oblique Three.js camera with a slow push-in showing three paper planes at separate depths (bulb z=0, wall z=-0.6, network z=-1.4) and the lantern back wall (z=-3)
Hidden warm lamp (z=-2) behind all cutouts; its light pools on the back wall and glows at paper cut edges
Near bulb layer: soft, broad rim and halo; far wall layer: crisper, tighter rim
Teal connected-system silhouette seen only through the slanted opening
Matte cards outside the bright cavity hold the label row and caption

beats.development: Lamp wakes behind LAYER 1; bulb silhouette edges and halo light up warm; label LAYER 1 turns teal; caption rises onto its matte card.
Light travels right behind LAYER 2; bulb rim dims while the far wall's left edge and opening edges catch a crisper rim; label LAYER 2 active.
Lamp slides behind the narrow opening; the third outline (node-and-link system) transmits teal and appears through the slit; label OPENING active.
Hold on the revealed connected system with camera settled; all copy readable.

findings: Each layer receives the light for about 0.7 s, enough to register its edge response before the hand-off.
All motion settles by 2.3 s, leaving a 0.7 s final hold.
justifiedHolds: 2.3–3.0 s hold on the last silhouette, as the style asks, and to read the caption.

notes: No reviewed recipes were supplied in STYLE.json tech.preview_recipes; the preview demonstrates the characteristic action: light moves behind two layers in order and reveals a third outline through a narrow opening.
Paper light transport is an illustrative shader approximation.
